content: An HbA1c target of less than 58 mmol/mol (7.5%) is recommended for individuals who are unable to recognize or articulate symptoms of hypoglycemia, have limited access to blood glucose monitoring or advanced insulin delivery technologies, or have non-glycemic factors that influence their HbA1c levels. Conversely, an HbA1c target of less than 48 mmol/mol (6.5%) may be appropriate for individuals who can safely achieve and maintain this level without significant risk.
